mapper.select: SELECT value::text FROM agent_preferences WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND preference_key = 'embeddings'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_preferences(user_id, preference_key, value) VALUES (CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid), 'embeddings', CAST(#{value, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR} AS jsonb)) ON CONFLICT (user_id, preference_key) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value, updated_at = now()
